g1-merge.title: Merge origin/main, regenerate map/INDEX.md
g1-merge.imperative: Reasoning gate -- crew-waived: LAUNCH_ORDER.md names dispatching a crew as itself a Stop Condition for this run ('You find yourself hand-editing map/INDEX.md, dispatching, or ending your turn with work pending') and instructs running the commands directly, in this context, as the first action. Run: git merge origin/main. Expect ONLY map/INDEX.md to conflict (measured with git merge-tree before the order was written). If any file other than map/INDEX.md conflicts, STOP and report -- do not proceed. Do NOT hand-merge map/INDEX.md, pick hunks, or take one side: regenerate it via `python -m scripts.code_map build --root .`, then `git add map/INDEX.md && git commit` to close the merge.

postconditions.statement: the merge is closed (no pending MERGE_HEAD)
the regenerated map is verifiably current -- tests/test_code_map.py green
no file other than map/INDEX.md conflicted during the merge
postconditions.satisfied_by: git merge-tree HEAD origin/main before merging showed exactly: 'CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in map/INDEX.md' and 'Auto-merging scripts/install_constellation.py' -- no other file listed as conflicting. git status --porcelain after 'git merge origin/main' showed exactly one UU entry: map/INDEX.md. Confirmed no other file conflicted.

constraints: Do not hand-merge or pick hunks in map/INDEX.md -- regenerate only.
Files outside map/INDEX.md are not this gate's to edit while resolving (LAUNCH_ORDER File Ownership).

structural: map/INDEX.md -- generated file, regenerated by scripts/code_map.py build
constraint: constraint:map-is-generated -- map/INDEX.md is never hand-authored, only regenerated
decision: decision:map-regen-not-hand-merge -- map/INDEX.md conflicts are resolved by regeneration, never by hand-editing hunks @grade: settled/human · leans g1-merge
evidence: tests/test_code_map.py reds on a stale map -- LAUNCH_ORDER.md
confidence_flags: map/INDEX.md -- DEGRADED-UNPARSEABLE at context (pre-merge); this gate's own regeneration is the fix, not a scout step

g2-verify-no-drop.title: Confirm #592's changes survived the merge
g2-verify-no-drop.imperative: Reasoning gate -- crew-waived, same basis as g1-merge. Confirm the merge did not drop any of #592's own changes against main: scripts/apply_episode_delta.py (the write-time guard, in the apply phase -- function _guard), tests/test_episode_observation_guard_at_write.py (RED/GREEN/control, git-free), scripts/install_constellation.py (bundling the guard), tests/data/store_mentions.approved.txt, and map/INDEX.md. If the merge appears to drop any of it, STOP and report (Stop Conditions) rather than restoring it yourself here.

postconditions.statement: all five listed artifacts are present post-merge and the guard function is intact

check.command: test -f scripts/apply_episode_delta.py && test -f tests/test_episode_observation_guard_at_write.py && test -f scripts/install_constellation.py && test -f tests/data/store_mentions.approved.txt && test -f map/INDEX.md && grep -q 'def _guard' scripts/apply_episode_delta.py

constraints: scripts/apply_episode_delta.py, tests/test_episode_observation_guard_at_write.py, scripts/install_constellation.py are NOT this run's to edit -- confirm only, do not modify.
